content.title: Hawks vs. Knicks Prediction, NBA Playoff Picks, Spread – 4/18/26
content.text: The Atlanta Hawks vs. New York Knicks playoff game is set to tip off at 6:00 p.m. ET on Saturday, April 18, with the Knicks entering as 6.5-point favorites on the spread, via PrizePicks.Atlanta and New York add another chapter to their rivalry with what is surely to be a heated first-round playoff matchup. Instead of facing the Knicks's public enemy, PG Trae Young, they will be met by a new-look Hawks team led by breakout star F Jalen Johnson. These teams met three times in the regular season, with the Knicks winning the season series 2-1.Below, we'll break down our Hawks vs. Knicks prediction and picks for Saturday’s NBA Playoff game, including the spread, over/under, and key player picks for PrizePicks.Make your picks for Hawks vs. Knicks on PrizePicks now.Hawks vs. Knicks Prediction, Spread, Over/Under – Saturday, April 18It’s been an incredibly fun season for Hawks fans, but a first-round victory over their rivals from New York would be icing on the cake. Atlanta has shed the weight of its past by trading away its once face of the franchise, PG Trae Young. Instead, they it has chosen to embrace its youth movement, highlighted by F Jalen Johnson and SG Nickeil Alexander-Walker.Johnson set a Hawks record for triple-doubles in a season with 13 this season, tied with PG Josh Giddey for the second-most in the NBA. He is clearly the foundation of this franchise and will likely have to be at his very best if Atlanta is to pull off the first-round upset.The Knicks had a fantastic regular season in their own right. They finished the year with two more wins than last season but still occupy the same No. 3 seed they had in the 2025 playoffs. They reached the conference finals last year and will look to build on their disappointing loss to the Indiana Pacers and get back to the NBA Finals for the first time since 1999. At home, New York is 27-13-0 (67.5%) ATS, by far the best home covering record in the NBA. On the road, they are 15-26-0 (36.6%) ATS, tied for the worst road covering record. Fortunately for them, tonight’s game is at Madison Square Garden.The Knicks may possess a sizeable advantage on the glass over Atlanta. New York ranks fifth in the NBA in total rebounding percentage (52.2%) compared to Atlanta, who rank 17th (49.5%).The Hawks have done an impressive job of forcing turnovers, but more importantly, scoring points off those turnovers. They rank fourth in points scored off opponents' turnovers at 17.4%.This will be difficult to replicate against the Knicks, who give up just 7.3 steals per game, the second-fewest in the league.Hawks vs. Knicks Player Picks, Stats for PrizePicks – 4/18/26Here are the top Hawks vs. Knicks picks to target on PrizePicks for Saturday, April 18.
